FaQs

Can’t find the answer you’re looking for?
Please chat to our friendly team
or write us an email at
‍info@unistation.com

  • What types of study programs do you offer?

    We offer guidance for bachelor’s, master’s, and language programs across top universities worldwide — tailored to each student’s goals and background.

  • Do you help with university applications?

    Yes, our team assists with every step — from choosing the right university and program to completing applications and preparing documents.

  • Can I apply if I haven’t decided on a destination yet?

    Absolutely! Our advisors will help you explore your options and recommend the best study destinations based on your interests and budget.

  • Do you provide visa support?

    Yes, we guide students through the visa application process to ensure a smooth and successful submission.

  • Are there scholarship opportunities?

    Yes, we help students identify and apply for scholarships offered by universities and international organizations.

  • Do you offer language preparation courses?

    Yes, we provide preparation courses for IELTS, TOEFL, and other language exams required by universities.
